title: LRHE independent claim-adjudication output
description: One record per judge invocation. Reconciled from handoff/2026-07-27-opencode/schema/judge-output.schema.json, which the harness never read: that copy named the matched label `matched_label_id` while `judge_lrhe.cmd_ingest` reads `label_id`, so a reply valid against the published schema would have been ingested with no label at all and every CONFIRMED verdict would have lost the 1:1 matching it exists to establish. `label_id` wins because it is what the code reads and what `score_lrhe` writes to `judge_label_id`; the archived name is accepted nowhere.

judge_id.description: `<run_id>|<claim_rid>|<judge_family>`, echoed from the prompt. Ingest matches on it and discards a reply it cannot match, so a judge that rewrites this has not answered

verdict.description: the archived copy also allowed REFUTED and UNRESOLVED. Both are removed. REFUTED is produced by the separate cold-refutation pass and folded in through exec.jsonl, never asserted by a judge; UNRESOLVED had no consumer -- `VERDICTS` is a three-tuple, so ingest counted such a reply as unmatched and dropped it silently. A judge that cannot decide returns PLAUSIBLE, which is the interim verdict that moves no headline number

label_id.description: the ground-truth label this claim matches, from the labels supplied in the prompt, or null. Required to be present: absent and null are the same value here only because the judge was shown the label set, so `I did not say` and `none matched` cannot be distinguished after the fact

rationale.description: one sentence. Truncated at 400 by ingest, so anything longer is discarded rather than stored

verification_status.description: optional. No judge executes anything today, so `not_executed` is the only honest value and the field is not required
